review_description: Sales and quote very good installation was prompt just got it in before the rains beganVery helpful with grid connection and advice on what to do next

The salesman was factual, answered questions straight away without hesitation, was friendly and knowledgeable. The installation was very quick, they were so polite, punctual and tidy. This company organised everything so all I had to do was sign the paperwork. Another great thing was I didn't have to apply for finance. It all goes through Humm
Still waiting as address differs from that is lodged with Ausgrid
The team from powersmart solutions were great to deal with no pressure to sign.From home visit to installation they were very professional.
The team did a great job today with our installation. They even waited out the rain to finish off the job. We're very happy.Thanks
Very informative from the outset. No pressure from the sales team. Installation was arranged really quickly.

Powersmart sales representative spent over an hour explaining everything even though he knew we were waiting on other quotes. Although other quotes were a little cheaper for the same thing we decided to go with powersmart because of the face to face service. The sales representative returned for a second visit to go over everything again as my husband was unavailable for his first visit.Installation was prompt, installers were lovely and the installation was performed professionally. When  they encounted a problem they came to talk to us and explained what they were doing to rectify it.Customer service has been great, all communication to our service provider was emailed to me us as well to keep us informed.
Sales process was thorough and explained things very well. Installation was professional and on time. Customer service was very supportive and provided all the necessary information

The sales process was very professional, they came to our house to discuss in full. Negotiable on price and once agreed we had an install date locked in for the following week. The installers were excellent, a tidy job, on time. The whole process was seamless. Any small have been quickly resolved.
He was happy with there sale and installation they where on time, tidy and polite. Yes they did organise it.
So happy with everything from the initial queries to the installation. Everyone was very professional and great customer service.

Sales, quote, and install was smooth except it was calculated to produce more than it does and now we are paying a interest free loan plus still half of our normal electrical account on top of the loan.  Not happy At all with aftermarket help.  Calls remain unreturned by thier admin team.  Would not recommend.
Very professional company to deal with that answered all of my questions and queries and kept me informed of progress with design, installation and commissioning of the system.

Marc from Powersmart Solar has been so helpful and responsive to my every query.  I live in public housing and he provided all the paperwork and addressed questions raised by ACT Housing to their satisfaction.  I am not certain of the value for money side of things, but I have seen similar systems offered in ads by other companies for about the same price.  I feel that if all systems are ok technically and cost about the same as each other, then I would always make the decision based on the excellent customer service provided by Marc when choosing or recommending a supplier.By the way your website and regular information on saving power and checking that your customers are getting the best service is great too!

Powersmart Solar's professionalism was of the highest callibre - they were honest, upfront and answered every question accurately.  I know I had very high expectations of work quality, and Shane and Marc exceeded these.  Their consideration and attention to detail has given us a solar installation 2nd to none.  Even their electrical contractors installed the wiring out of view as I requested in our flat roofed home with challenging and limited access points.  Being a large domestic installation, I was impressed by their many projects on many of the schools and colleges locally.The alternate quote was friendly enough, but failed due to poor planning (suggesting 700m trenches would be required adding considerable cost!!), poor customer details management, and not wishing to answer questions in writing as requested.Thank you Finn - it can be confusing when you start to research a solar installation, but I was able to navigate my way to final installation intially with your help followed with the team at Powersmart Solar.

Price: Not the lowest but the best value for money.Components supplied: installers that I talked to spoke well of the inverter, mounting etcFor my peace of mind, I  did not want cheapest system with totally obscure components which might not be repairable down the road for lack of parts.Mounting: We don't get gale force winds but I like the idea that Powersmart provide a better than average structural support for panels.Service rep: prompt response, very patient and helpful with my questions, no hard sell.Installer: friendly, efficient, happy to answer yet more of my questions.Schools around Canberra have used Powersmart. Admittedly this guarantees nothing but I was reassured that they weren't fly by night operators.
Marc and the team at Powersmart put the effort in to explaining the details and provided a complete service from system design to layout. They answered any questions we had promptly and accurately.
